# Frontera Global

> Behavioural intelligence for healthcare. AI-driven research, strategy and creative engagement that helps healthcare teams change behaviour and deliver real-world impact.

Frontera Global combines behavioural science with its Connected Behavioural Intelligence System™ to model how patients and professionals make decisions, then designs interventions across launch strategy, journey mapping, and engagement.
